name: Borobudur
_about: BOROBUDUR (c. 800): the foot, five square terraces redented toward their middles, their galleries walled in by balustrades of niches (a Buddha in each of the first's, a little stupa over every one), three round terraces ringed by 72 perforated bell stupas, and the great stupa at the summit; the stairs straight up the four axes, cut into the terraces they climb.
